summary.text: Jessica Giannino is a Democratic state representative from the 16th Suffolk District who has served in the Massachusetts House of Representatives since January 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A former Revere Counselor at Large, she is vice chair of the Joint Committee on Economic Development and Emerging Technologies.

paragraphs.text: Jessica Giannino graduated from Revere High School in 2010 and from Salem State University in 2014.
Her legislative biography lists her profession as account manager and her prior public service as Counselor at Large for the City of Revere.
Giannino took office on January 6, 2021, succeeding RoseLee Vincent.
In addition to her vice chair post, she serves on the House Committee on Human Resources and Employee Engagement and the Joint Committee on Cannabis Policy.
